title: Milk Yield Enhancer

sections.heading: Milk Yield Enhancer
sections.text: During lactation, dairy cows face nutritional deficits that can diminish milk yield and quality. Imbalanced energy and protein levels lead to metabolic stress and inefficient nutrient use. Milk Yield Enhancer is designed to complement conventional dairy feed by providing a balanced blend of phytoactives and essential bio-trace minerals. This synergistic formulation fills critical nutritional gaps, ensuring sustained energy release and improved milk production. Components Rumen-protected fat NPN Soluble sugars Protein Cocktail enzymes Yeast metabolites Hydroxy Amino Acid chelates Herbal galactagogues
